tasks.short: Train and supervise other cardiology technologists and students.

steps.what: Read the mail asking to train other cardiology technologists and students
Supervise the student during the cardiology study in the room
Open studies the student already stored on the cardiology record
Read the training standard for cardiology technologists and students
Draft a training note from the student's stored studies
Check the training note against the student who was supervised
Commit the accepted training note on the cardiology record

tasks.design: The request to train arrives in {EMAIL}. A template on the {OTHER} cardiology record drafts a training note from the student's stored studies and the {DOCS} training standard, and it stops there. The cardiology technologist checks that note against the student they supervised, and a later step commits that accepted version on the {OTHER} record.
tasks.previous_blocker: The note mixed a few stored study fields with a judgement about what the student actually did in the room.
tasks.enabler_now: Completed studies already sit as fields on the cardiology record, so a template can assemble a draft and hold it.
tasks.still_hard: Judging the student in the room, and keeping a training note from becoming a score of that person.
tasks.human_edge: Only the technologist who stood there knows whether the student did the study the stored fields describe.
tasks.altitude: The same time stays in the room with the student. The technologist gains no right to credit a student they did not watch.

reach.task: Supervise a student through a vascular ultrasound study.
reach.learn: Which stored study fields may enter a training note, and when to refuse the note because the student did not do that view.

evidence.claim: A training note can be assembled from study fields that are already stored, and held until a person accepts the wording.
Measurements and notes from a heart study are health data and a special category.
The medical dossier is kept for years, and a patient may ask who viewed it.
Logging corrections to a colleague's work can count as staff monitoring that a works council is asked about.

assumptions: Means prior was screens 1.4, spreadsheets 0.5, mail 3.9, documents 13.4, in person 80.7. Largest remainder gives screens 1, spreadsheets 1, mail 4, documents 13, in person 81. The spreadsheet point is the training note, not a tally, so it folds into documents: screens 1, mail 4, documents 14, in person 81.

Structured input for the draft is study id, date, student name, and views already stored. The producer is the step that opens those stored studies. If a field is empty, the draft does not run and the technologist writes the note.

The machine draft is not gated. The check names accepted training note v1 and does not release it. Only the commit writes that version, and it does not change the wording. A rejected draft is not committed. A later wording change is a new draft and needs a new check.
In-person supervision stays at its full share. The design does not shorten time with the student.
Focal upkeep is zero. The check time is already in the remaining review step. Keeping the field map aligned is system time and is not deducted from the role.
The design does not score the student and does not allocate training places.
unknowns: Whether this hospital stores each student's completed views as fields, or only as free text.
Whether a training note that names a patient study must sit in that patient's dossier.
Whether logging a refused training note counts as staff monitoring under national works-council rules.
research_questions: Which fields on the cardiology record are filled before the technologist leaves the room?
Who besides the supervising technologist may commit a training note?

already_counted.description: The technologist still checks the training note against the student. That time stays in the check step.

incremental.description: Keep the training-note field map aligned when the cardiology record adds a study field.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is no saving when the student's studies are not stored as fields. High is the draft only, when the note still needs a wording change before commit. The commit itself is the other saved point, and supervision is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compare heart wall thickness and chamber sizes with standard norms.

steps.what: Read the cardiologist note about this heart study
Read wall thickness and chamber sizes on the patient
Read stored wall thickness and chamber sizes
Read the standard norms for heart wall measurements
Compare stored measurements with standard norms by range
Check which abnormalities the range comparison may identify
Commit the accepted measurement comparison on the study

tasks.design: A {EMAIL} note from the cardiologist sets the heart study. The {OTHER} cardiology record compares stored wall thickness and chamber sizes with its standard norms and holds a draft that does not name an abnormality. The cardiology technologist decides which abnormalities that draft may identify, and a later step commits the accepted comparison.
tasks.previous_blocker: Marking a number against a norm was easy, but naming an abnormality needed the person who saw that heart.
tasks.enabler_now: Wall thickness, chamber sizes, and the lab norms are already stored numbers, so a range flag can be configured and held as a draft.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding that a flagged number is an abnormality in this patient, and keeping this lab's norms current.
tasks.human_edge: Only the technologist can say that a number outside the norm is an abnormality on this study.
tasks.altitude: The same time stays with the patient. The technologist gains no right to diagnose from a range flag.

reach.task: Compare a stored vessel diameter with that lab's norm range.
reach.learn: Which measurement fields are stored before a range draft runs, and when a flag is not an abnormality.

evidence.claim: A stored measurement can be marked when it falls outside a stored low and high. That mark does not name the abnormality.
Software with a medical purpose is regulated as a medical device.
Heart measurements are health data and a special category.
Large-scale processing of health data needs a data protection impact assessment.

assumptions: Means prior was screens 9.3, spreadsheets 2.7, mail 1.6, documents 16.6, in person 69.8. Largest remainder gives screens 9, spreadsheets 3, mail 2, documents 16, in person 70. Measurements and norms live on the cardiology system, so the spreadsheet points fold into screens: screens 12, mail 2, documents 16, in person 70.

Structured input is each wall thickness and chamber size already stored, plus that lab's low and high for the same measurement. The producer is the step that reads the stored measurements. If a measurement or a norm is missing, the compare does not run.

The range draft does not name an abnormality and is not gated. The check names accepted measurement comparison v1. Only the commit writes that version, and it does not change the wording. A later edit is a new draft and needs a new check.
Time on the patient stays at its full share. The design does not shorten the study.
Focal upkeep is zero. The check time is already in the remaining review step. Keeping the norm table aligned is system time and is not deducted from the role.
Test whether the cardiology record already flags a number outside a stored norm before adding custom code. The flag must stay a draft.
unknowns: Which norm table this lab uses, and who may change a low or a high.
Whether this cardiology record's existing device status already covers a range flag on wall thickness and chamber size.
research_questions: Are wall thickness and each chamber size stored as numbers before the report is written?
Does the cardiologist receive the comparison inside the study, or also by mail?

already_counted.description: The technologist still decides which abnormalities the range flags. That time stays in the check step.

incremental.description: Keep the norm low and high aligned when the lab changes a standard norm.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is no saving when a wall thickness, a chamber size, or a norm is missing. High is the range compare only, when the person still rewrites the abnormality wording before commit. Time on the patient is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record vascular information seen and heard on the ultrasound screen.

steps.what: Observe the ultrasound display screen and listen to signals
Read blood pressure and oxygen saturation on the monitor
Draft vascular information from stored pressure and saturation
Add limb volume changes and cerebral circulation to the draft
Check the vascular information against the ultrasound screen
Commit the accepted vascular information record

tasks.design: The cardiology technologist watches the ultrasound display and listens to the signals. The {OTHER} record copies stored blood pressure and oxygen saturation into a vascular draft and stops. The technologist adds limb volume changes and cerebral circulation, checks the draft against the screen, and a later step commits the accepted vascular information.
tasks.previous_blocker: Blood pressure and oxygen saturation are numbers on the monitor, but limb volume and cerebral circulation are what the technologist sees and hears.
tasks.enabler_now: Once the technologist has marked the limb and the moment, pressure and saturation can already be stored numbers.
tasks.still_hard: The technologist must still watch the screen and listen. The monitor does not hear cerebral circulation.
tasks.human_edge: Listening to the signal, and judging limb volume change or cerebral circulation, stays with the technologist.
tasks.altitude: The same time stays at the ultrasound screen. The technologist gains no right to record a signal they did not hear.

reach.task: Record blood flow signals from a duplex ultrasound display.
reach.learn: Which monitor numbers are stored for the marked limb, and which findings still have to be added by the person who listened.

evidence.claim: A monitor can pass blood pressure and oxygen saturation as numbers after the technologist marks the limb and the time. It does not pass limb volume change or cerebral circulation.
Vascular measurements are health data and a special category.
The medical dossier is kept for years, and a patient may ask who viewed it.

assumptions: Means prior was screens 2.4, spreadsheets 0.3, mail 0.3, documents 9.5, in person 87.4. Largest remainder gives screens 3, spreadsheets 0, mail 0, documents 10, in person 87. Nothing is folded.

Structured input for the monitor draft is blood pressure and oxygen saturation already stored for the marked limb and time. The producer is the step that reads the monitor. Limb volume change and cerebral circulation have no stored field. The person adds them as a draft, which is not a release.
The monitor draft is not gated. The person's added findings are not gated. The check names accepted vascular information v1. Only the commit writes that version, and it does not change the wording.
Time at the screen stays at its full share. The design does not shorten observation or listening.
Focal upkeep is zero. The check time is already in the remaining review step. Keeping the monitor field map aligned is system time and is not deducted from the role.
Configure the existing monitor feed before custom code. If pressure or saturation is not stored for that limb, the draft does not run.
unknowns: Whether this monitor stores blood pressure and oxygen saturation for the marked limb, or only shows them.
Whether limb volume change or cerebral circulation is ever stored as a number on this device.
research_questions: Who marks the limb and the moment on the monitor today, the technologist or another person in the room?
Does the vascular note stay on the cardiology record, or move to a separate vascular record?

already_counted.description: The technologist still checks vascular information against the screen. That time stays in the check step.

incremental.description: Keep the monitor field map for pressure and saturation aligned when the device export changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is no saving when pressure and saturation are not stored for that limb. High is the monitor copy only. Limb volume changes and cerebral circulation stay with the person who listened. Time at the screen is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate valve areas and assess cardiac physiology.

steps.what: Read an earlier note on this cardiac valve
Read blood flow velocity on the patient
Confirm stored blood flow velocity measurements
Calculate valve areas from the stored velocity measurements
Assess cardiac physiology from the valve area draft
Check the valve study against the velocity tracing
Commit the accepted valve study without editing it

tasks.design: An earlier {EMAIL} note may name the cardiac valve. The {OTHER} cardiology record calculates valve areas from stored blood flow velocity measurements and holds the numbers as a draft. The technologist assesses cardiac physiology, checks that study against the tracing, and a later step commits the accepted valve study without changing it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Valve area is arithmetic on several velocities, but cardiac physiology is a judgement of that tracing, not a product of the formula.
tasks.enabler_now: The continuity relation is fixed arithmetic on velocities the cardiology record can already store, so the area can be held as a draft.
tasks.still_hard: A poor tracing still has to be refused by the person. The formula does nothing if one velocity was not stored.
tasks.human_edge: The formula returns an area. Whether the cardiac physiology makes sense is the technologist's judgement.
tasks.altitude: The same time stays on taking velocities. The technologist gains no right to release a valve study they have not assessed.

reach.task: Calculate a valve or vessel area from stored velocity measurements.
reach.learn: Which velocity fields must be stored before the area draft runs, and when the tracing makes that area unusable.

evidence.claim: Valve area by the continuity relation is outflow-tract area times outflow-tract velocity time integral, divided by valve velocity time integral. That product is not an assessment of physiology.
Software with a medical purpose is regulated as a medical device.
Large-scale processing of health data needs a data protection impact assessment.

assumptions: Means prior was screens 6.9, spreadsheets 8.2, mail 1.5, documents 14.4, in person 69.0. Largest remainder gives screens 7, spreadsheets 8, mail 2, documents 14, in person 69. The formula runs on stored velocities in the cardiology system, not on a separate tally, so the spreadsheet points fold into screens: screens 15, mail 2, documents 14, in person 69.

Structured input is outflow-tract area or diameter, outflow-tract velocity time integral, and valve velocity time integral, already stored. The producer is the step that confirms those measurements. If one is missing, the calculation does not run. Physiology words are not calculated.

The area draft is not gated. The physiology wording is a separate draft and is not gated. The check names accepted valve study v1 and does not rewrite it. Only the commit writes that version. A later edit is a new draft and needs a new check.
Time on the patient stays at its full share. The design does not shorten velocity acquisition.
Focal upkeep is zero. The check time is already in the remaining review step. Keeping field names and the continuity constants aligned is system time and is not deducted from the role.
Use the area the cardiology record already computes, if it has one, and hold it unpublished. If it does not, the same fields feed a deterministic calculation. That fallback is still not a release.
unknowns: Whether this lab stores outflow-tract diameter rather than outflow-tract area.
Whether this cardiology record's existing device status already covers a valve-area calculation.
research_questions: Are the three velocity inputs stored as numbers before anyone writes the report?
Who may change the continuity constants this lab uses?

already_counted.description: The technologist still checks the valve study against the tracing. That time stays in the check step.

incremental.description: Keep the velocity field names and continuity constants aligned when the cardiology record changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is no saving when a velocity input is missing. High is most of the formula, when one velocity still has to be read off the tracing by hand. Physiology and time on the patient stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The same time stays with the patient, the student, and the clinical judgement. Less retyping of monitor values and less hand calculation of valve area. No new right to diagnose, and no score of a student.
skills_to_grow: Read a stored study, velocity, or monitor value before a draft runs.
Refuse a training note, a range flag, or a valve area when the stored fields do not match what was seen or heard.
role.ambitious_version: The technologist could have valve areas ready for every study the same day, and still assess physiology in the room.
